chunks: And from him, from Ibn Miskan, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If the slave kills the free man, then he is handed over to the heirs of the free man, and there is nothing upon his masters.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءِ: the legal heirs or entitled kin of the victim
key_terms.ٱلْحُرَّ: the free person who was killed
key_terms.ٱلْعَبْدُ: the slave who committed the killing

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave kills a free man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation and liability when a slave kills a free person. The slave is to be surrendered to the heirs of the slain free person, and no further liability falls upon the slave’s masters.
